research_findings: Discovered an open TODO in src/app/actions/waitlist.ts to rate-limit waitlist signups before heavy traffic.
Identified that the application lacked a centralized rate limiter class.
Found an error 'Cannot access refs during render' in src/components/landing/AdaptiveCoachDemo.tsx due to preferReducedMotion ref being accessed during render.
features_improved: Fixed React hook linting error in AdaptiveCoachDemo component by replacing a useRef with a useState to ensure safe rendering updates.
Added memory leak prevention to rate limiter by providing tests and implementations for cleaning up the background interval using unref().
new_features_added: Implemented a new in-memory RateLimiter class in src/lib/rate-limit.ts with automated cleanup of expired entries.
Integrated the RateLimiter into the joinWaitlist server action in src/app/actions/waitlist.ts, limiting requests by IP address.
next_steps_for_next_run: Monitor waitlist rate-limiter logs for actual traffic patterns and adjust limits.
Review other public-facing API routes for similar rate-limiting needs (e.g., feedback submissions).
Investigate upgrading in-memory rate limiting to Redis if server scaling beyond single instance becomes necessary.
